answer_1.quote: We also show that sensitivity can be used as an additional reward in paraphrase-based attacks to improve the attack success rate of adversarial models.

answer_2.quote: Attack Success Rate: Following Wang et al. ( ), we evaluate our attack methods using the Attack Success Rate (ASR).

answer_4.quote: Humans evaluate SPE and GRM on a Likert scale of 1-5 (least to most). CHO is 1 if a human considers the generated paraphrase adversarial, else 0.
